verdict.rationale: Runpod documents Serverless endpoints whose Flex workers scale to zero when idle and bill per second from worker start to stop, with FlashBoot to cut cold starts. Developers can deploy their own code via Flash, which scaffolds GPU/CPU workers, and manage endpoints via the CLI and the Python/JS/Go SDKs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of autoscaling configuration (worker min/max, scaling triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration of serverless scale-to-zero behavior.
